description: We are Crimson Horizon, a team of two passionate students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are building Mars Memory Map, an interactive storytelling platform that brings the journeys, discoveries and legacies of NASA's Mars exploration missions to life. We are interested in space exploration, AI, technology, software development and creative problem-solving. We welcome collaboration and innovative ideas!
summary: Mars & Moon Memory Map is an interactive educational platform that preserves and explores the stories of robotic and human exploration equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through interactive 3D globes, users can discover mission landing sites, explore spacecraft histories, understand why missions ended, and learn about the scientific legacy of these machines. The platform features mission stories, an equipment archive, interactive mission simulations, historical timelines, quizzes, and a comparison of lunar and Martian exploration. A virtual guide, M.A.R.S., helps users navigate the experience and understand mission records. By combining scientific information, interactive mapping, and storytelling, the project aims to make planetary exploration more engaging while ensuring that the achievements and legacy of past missions are not forgotten.
details:
Mars & Moon Memory Map is an interactive platform, designed to bring the stories of lunar and Martian exploration equipment to life.

The project combines interactive 3D planetary maps with mission histories, equipment archives, timelines, educational quizzes, and mission simulations. Users can explore where missions landed, learn about the machines they left behind, understand why some missions ended, and discover the scientific contributions they made.

The experience includes M.A.R.S. (Mission Assistant & Rover Storyteller), a virtual guide that helps users navigate the platform and learn about different missions. The project also compares lunar and Martian exploration to highlight how space agencies have explored these two worlds.

Our goal is to make space exploration more accessible and engaging while preserving the history, achievements, and scientific legacy of equipment left on the Moon and Mars.
